it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e assumiu a prefeitura em 02/04/2026, depois que Mateus Trojan renunciou ao cargo para concorrer a deputado estadual na eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and took over as mayor on April 2, 2026, after Mayor Mateus Trojan resigned to run for state deputy in the 2026 election.

it.n: Francisco de Assis Paz de Amor
Flavinho Togni de Lima e Silva
